'''Alpha Leader''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Villian Dance]] while leading [[Alpha Squadron]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] sometime in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
